newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the 30-share Dow Jones industrial average fell 1.12 points to 6,346.91, as investors took profits after the market's eight-session stampede into record territory.
* The General Election Institute announced on Monday that Indonesia will hold general elections on May 29 next year.
* The Jakarta composite index ended up 3.97 points, or 0.64 percent, at 620.86 on Monday, hovering firmly above the psychological 600-point level on offshore support.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be slightly lower at the opening on Tuesday on profit-taking in some counters after big increases in the past few days.
* Textile firm Apac Centertex following reports that it had posted a nine-month net profit of 15.43 billion rupiah, up 3,141 percent from the same period last year after aquiring a textile firm.

* Cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna following stock splits which come into effect on Monday coupled with ratings from Standard and Poors. On Monday, Standard and Poors affirmed its BBB-plus local currency corporate credit rating on PT HM Sampoerna. It also affirmed its BBB foreign currency rating on a $200 million note.
* Property firms PT Lippo Land and PT Lippo Karawaci following shareholders' decisions to pay final dividends of 60 rupiah and 40 rupiah per share respectively.
